description: Analyzes open invoices by age (30/60/90+ days) and sends escalating follow-up emails to overdue clients. Returns invoice count, total overdue amount, and emails sent per bucket.

aging_buckets.description: Optional custom aging thresholds in days, e.g. [30, 60, 90]. Defaults to [30, 60, 90].

escalate_at.description: Days overdue at which to escalate to a senior contact or legal notice. Defaults to 90.

send_emails.description: If true, sends follow-up emails to overdue clients. Defaults to true.

name: yax_collect_ar_invoices

buckets.description: Invoice counts per aging bucket: bucket_30, bucket_60, bucket_90_plus.

total_overdue_usd.description: Total USD value of overdue invoices.
